state.transcript: Priya opened with the incident summary: on Tuesday the primary database failed over twice, each time for about four minutes, because a storage controller firmware update was rolled out without the staged canary that the runbook requires. Checkout errors peaked at 18 percent. Marco said payments retried most failed charges automatically but roughly 2,300 customers saw a double authorization hold that released within 48 hours; support received 640 tickets about it. Dev asked for a macro that explains the hold and a dashboard of open tickets by category. Aiko reported that offline mode for the mobile app is in beta with 4 percent of users and the remaining blocker is a sync conflict when two devices edit the same shopping list. Lena raised that the firmware rollout bypassed change review and asked for an audit of every production change made without approval in the last 90 days. Decisions: the firmware runbook gets a mandatory canary gate; support gets the macro by Friday; the audit starts Monday and Lena owns it; offline mode stays at 4 percent until the sync conflict is fixed. Marco is against a blanket discount and prefers targeted outreach to customers who contacted support.
